description: Extract HTML tables from a public URL (SSRF-safe fetch) or an HTML string into clean JSON: header detection (thead or leading th rows, multi-row headers joined), rowspan / colspan expansion, captions, rows as objects keyed by header or as arrays, optional number parsing ("$1,234.50", "45%"), and table choice by index or CSS selector (e.g. table.wikitable). Layout tables with too few rows are skipped. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/html-tables

header.description: auto = thead / all-th rows; first = first row is the header; none = no header

index.description: Only the table at this 0-based position (after selector)

minRows.description: Skip tables with fewer data rows

selector.description: CSS selector choosing tables, e.g. table.wikitable or #results table

name: html_tables
title: Html Tables
